sectors.trend: Divergent: iron ore under pressure from China demand cracks and Xi political instability; gold and silver exploration names (Platina, Dalaroo, Broken Hill, Larvotto, Forrestania) showing strong assay and resource growth; rare earths (Dalaroo/Greenland) gaining strategic interest
sectors.implications: Rotate from BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX exposure toward gold (PLA.AX, BHP gold segment) and rare earths; coal demand spike from Hormuz crisis supports BHP.AX coal division and AGL.AX

sectors.trend: RBA hawkish tilt (Bullock) and rate fears pressure valuations; housing market stress in Sydney raises NIM and credit risk concerns; government debt cliff pressures sovereign credit spreads
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure from rate sensitivity; monitor NIM vs credit cost; REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) pressured by higher discount rates

sectors.trend: Saudi oil shock and diesel shortage ($6.48/gal US) driving fuel cost inflation; Hormuz crisis boosting coal demand; energy prices dumping on US Democrat sweep expectations creating volatility
sectors.implications: Woods Point (WPU.AX), AGL.AX, Origin (ORG.AX) benefit from coal demand; fuel cost inflation pressures transport and consumer sectors; Woodside (WDS.AX) exposed to oil price swings

sectors.trend: ASX tech stocks rallied on Wall Street strength; China rebalancing toward robots supports ASX-listed automation plays; data centre buildout straining net zero targets; consumer staples under fuel-cost pressure
sectors.implications: ASX tech (WES.AX, XRO.AX) benefits from global tech momentum; China robot theme supports supply-chain names; WES.AX/WOW.AX face margin squeeze from fuel inflation

sectors.trend: Public hospital funding gaps (Royal Children's, Albury) signal potential private healthcare demand; aged care provider wage arrears ($1m+) highlight sector stress; REITs pressured by rate environment
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX, IAG.AX (health insurance) benefit from public system strain; REITs (GPW.AX, SPG.AX) face headwinds from Bullock hawkishness

China demand fragility: iron ore downside, Xi political cracks, robot rebalancing
Fiscal sustainability: government debt cliff, Intergenerational Report migration lock-in

El Nino climate risk to agriculture and insurance sectors

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce rate-sensitive REIT and property exposure; favour fixed-income ladders; monitor RBA statement language

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global diesel/oil supply shock (Saudi, Iran, Ukraine, Hormuz)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge fuel-cost exposure; favour energy producers (WDS.AX, AGL.AX); reduce transport/consumer discretionary

risk_assessment.risk_factor: China demand deterioration / iron ore price decline
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate to gold and rare earths exposure

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Sydney housing market correction / credit stress
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce REIT exposure; monitor bank NIM and credit provisions; favour defensive healthcare

risk_assessment.risk_factor: El Nino agricultural and insurance impact
risk_assessment.mitigation: Review SFR.AX, WBC.AX (agri exposure); IAG.AX, CGF.AX insurance claims risk
Monitor infrastructure and public-sector contractor exposure; favour cash-generative defensives

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and silver exploration names on iron ore rotation and safe-haven demand
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore downside, China uncertainty, and strong assay results (Platina $2M Rio cheque, Dalaroo assays, Broken Hill sulphides, Larvotto concentrate) support sector re-rating

opportunities.recommendation: Add coal and energy exposure on Hormuz-driven demand spike
opportunities.rationale: Hormuz crisis pushing global coal demand to record high; diesel shortage to 2027 supports energy producers

opportunities.recommendation: Selective tech/automation exposure on China robot rebalancing theme
opportunities.rationale: China shifting capital toward robotics; ASX tech rallied on Wall Street strength; data centre buildout supports infrastructure tech

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore-heavy mining and REIT exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore downside persists with China cracks; Bullock hawkishness pressures REIT valuations and housing

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge fuel-cost inflation risk in consumer and transport sectors
defensive_moves.rationale: Diesel at $6.48/gal, Saudi shock, and shortage to 2027 squeeze margins across consumer and logistics

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain healthcare and defensive staples allocation
defensive_moves.rationale: Public hospital funding gaps and aged care stress support private healthcare; defensives outperform in rate-hike environment

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to consolidate in a range as rate fears (Bullock hawkishness) offset tech rally momentum. Fuel price shock adds inflationary pressure, complicating RBA path. Iron ore weakness caps materials; gold and energy provide relative strength. Expect volatility around RBA communications and US energy policy shifts.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural migration-driven housing supply gap and government debt trajectory create medium-term headwinds for financials and REITs. China's robot rebalancing and iron ore softness favour a commodity rotation toward gold, rare earths, and coal. El Nino adds agricultural/insurance risk. Net: selective, sector-rotated approach over broad index exposure.
